status: the Windward Deep: an open pit sunk into the Rift floor, terraced in five rings. The buildings are town content and come after.
region: the_deep, traced from the owner's annotated heightmap (data/rift_regions.json)

form.why: The owner's form, at the owner's depth. Schema 1 built a sealed cavern with a domed roof, on the reasoning that 83 blocks down has ground overhead. That was circular: the ground is only overhead if the pit is not excavated through it. The Deep is the Rift's deepest point and must read as a shaft, not as another cavern -- the Displaced City already is one.
form.proportion: 83 deep against a widest span near 400, about 1 to 5. At y40 it would have been 1 to 9, which reads as a bowl. Proportion is why y0 (owner, 2026-09-23).
form.sees: the sky tear 360-400 blocks overhead, and the Rift's floor veins at the pit's rim

rings.why: Five rings stepping 17 from the Rift floor at y83 down to y0, each 36 blocks wide horizontally: the deepest point of the region is 177 from its wall. A 17-block riser cannot be climbed, so the city is the only way down and the tunnel still matters.
rings.one_structure: The rings ARE the city's levels. Schema 1 also had three decks at y0, y16 and y32; against these treads y32 coincides exactly and y16 sits one block off y15, so they were two systems doing one job, and platforms floating in the middle read as a chamber's mezzanines. The decks are gone (owner, 2026-09-23).

tread.why: Rechiseled is dressed masonry: wrong for a torn cliff, right for a built city, and its connecting variants stop a 36-wide street reading as a grid. A margin of bare rock at the back of each tread, against its riser, so the terrace reads as cut rock with a built surface rather than as a paved shelf.

restore.why: Everything under a tread must be rock. The sealed chamber schema 1 carved reached y22-52, which in the outer rings is BELOW the new tread at y66, so re-running over it would leave each street a thin shelf over a void. Every column is refilled from the shell up to its own tread before anything is laid, which also closes any natural cave.

shell.why: A ring of rock outside the pit, from under the floor to the surface, so no cave or aquifer opens into a wall. There is no roof to seal: the pit is open.

nbt.yOffset: int, the relative height it sends a player to

read_from_the_jar.who_it_moves: ServerPlayerEntity only: the bytecode takes List<class_3222>. Pokemon and NPCs cannot ride it.
read_from_the_jar.proved: On cobblers-dryrun9, 2026-09-22: setblock places it, data merge sets yOffset, and a fresh block reads {yOffset: 0, requiredAdvancement: ""} -- ungated by default, and a generated function configures every lift without anyone opening its screen.
read_from_the_jar.not_proved: That right-clicking actually teleports a player. That needs a player and is for the owner's flight.

lifts.why: The only way between rings, and so the only way down. A 17-block riser cannot be walked.

light.why: The Rift fuels the city: the same violet its veins use, set into the treads on a loose grid. Light 15, and it conditions no spawn.

spawn_policy: No block placed here may condition a spawn (data/spawn_blocks.json). lumymon:elevator and the galar particle block are both clean.

tunnel_mouth.why: Where Victory Road leaves the Deep. The tunnel itself is a separate pass and needs the League's final position.
